title: Искусство войны и сын Елены  (The Art of War and Elena's Son)

scenes.title: The Signature Omelet and Mom's Call
scenes.summary: At the apartment, Kostya makes his signature omelet for Nastya before her mother calls about wedding plans, while Ainura jokes about fines in the kitchen.

scenes.title: Ilya's Provocation in the Locker Room
scenes.summary: In the locker room, Ilya taunts Max about Sasha and then deliberately slams his own face into a locker so the staff will think Max beat him up.

scenes.title: Lyova's Morning Call
scenes.summary: Waking up in Elena Pavlovna's bed, Chef Barinov answers a worried morning phone call from Lyova and lies that he slept at the restaurant.

scenes.title: A Call from Her Son and Ordering Pizza
scenes.summary: Elena Pavlovna gets a phone call from her adult son Vasily and hides Barinov's presence just like he did with Lyova, before they order pizza for breakfast.

scenes.title: Explaining to Sasha and the Book on War
scenes.summary: Max tries in vain to convince Sasha that Ilya beat himself up, and then discovers a copy of Sun Tzu's The Art of War in the trash.

scenes.title: An Unexpected Visitor Instead of the Courier
scenes.summary: While Elena Pavlovna is in the shower, Chef Barinov opens the front door expecting the pizza delivery man and instead confronts Elena's tipsy adult son.

scenes.title: Meeting Elena's Son
scenes.summary: Elena Pavlovna rushes out of the bathroom to stop Chef Barinov from twisting the arm of her son Vasily, who rudely criticizes their relationship.

scenes.title: Two Red Hairs and a Dinner Invitation
scenes.summary: Max plucks two red hairs from Senya's head for his scheme against Ilya, while Chef Barinov calls Elena Pavlovna to invite her to dinner at Claude Monet.

scenes.title: Nagiyev's Favorite Table
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov orders Vika to reserve Nagiyev's favorite table for his dinner with Elena Pavlovna, confident that the owner will either not show up or forgive him.

scenes.title: Hairs in the Salad and a Fine for Senya
scenes.summary: Max slips Senya's two red hairs into a guest's salad to spark a feud, resulting in Vika docking the cost of the ruined dish from Senya's pay.

scenes.title: The Chef Becomes a Guest
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov selects the freshest beef from supplier Timur for his evening dinner and announces that Lyova will run the kitchen while Barinov dines as a guest.

scenes.title: Tasting the Pate and Nagiyev's Arrival
scenes.summary: Lyova nervously asks Louis to taste his pate before service, while Nagiyev arrives at the restaurant and finds Chef Barinov sitting in a suit at his favorite table.

scenes.title: Nagiyev Yields the Table and Max's New Plan
scenes.summary: Nagiyev graciously lets Barinov keep the lucky table for his date with Elena, while Fedya asks Max how he plans to set Ilya up next.

scenes.title: Questioning Kostya About Ilya's Weaknesses
scenes.summary: Pretending he wants to make peace with Ilya, Max tricks Kostya into telling him what Ilya cares about most so he can strike where it hurts.

scenes.title: Elena Brings Her Son to Dinner
scenes.summary: To Chef Barinov's dismay, Elena Pavlovna brings her son Vasily along to their romantic dinner, and Vasily immediately mocks Claude Monet's decor and lack of a show.

scenes.title: A Special Dinner and the Restroom Line
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov waves off the menu because he designed a custom dinner for Elena and Vasily, who heads to the restroom and picks a fight with Nagiyev in line.

scenes.title: The Scuffle with Nagiyev
scenes.summary: After Vasily splashes water on Nagiyev's suit in the restroom, Nagiyev drags him out by the collar until Chef Barinov and Elena Pavlovna intervene.

scenes.title: The Chef Steps In and Chaos in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov defends Vasily in front of Nagiyev and offers to pay for the dry cleaning, while Senya and Ilya clash after dishes are dropped in the dining room.

scenes.title: Brawl in the Dining Room and the Dead Fish
scenes.summary: A wild brawl erupts in the dining room to Vasily's delight, while Sasha and Kostya discover that Max poisoned the aquarium fish Ilya gave to Sasha.

scenes.title: The Price of Deception and Casualties of War
scenes.summary: Disgusted by Max's petty revenge on the innocent fish, Sasha and Kostya tell him nobody wants to see him at work or at home, while Vasily finally warms up to Barinov.
